summary: Banco Santander-Chile filed a Form 6-K reporting a local bond placement under an existing line of credit (No. 20220013). On May 15, 2026, it placed Series AA-14 dematerialized bearer bonds totaling 140,000 UF (~US$5.3 million), maturing December 1, 2028, at an average rate of 1.81%. This is an ordinary debt issuance, not a special situation.
